edge_cases_audited.name: fiscal_sequence_no allocation timing for kiosk-CASH (paid AT counter)
edge_cases_audited.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — at counter-collect (NOT at creation)
edge_cases_audited.evidence: CLAUDE.md §8 nominal contract: 'kiosk paid = sequence allocated at creation; POS cash = sequence allocated at close.' Kiosk-CASH (paid AT the counter, not at the kiosk) is the THIRD branch and follows the POS-cash timing — sequence allocated at counter-collect confirm, NOT at order creation. Code evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:266-267 creates the FrontendOrder with payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER + pos_payment_method=COUNTER_DEFERRED — NO `fiscal_sequence_no` set in the create() payload. Grep on FrontendOrderService.php for `fiscal_sequence_no` returns only the kiosk-CARD finalizePaidKioskOrder path (lines 1153-1159 — auto-allocate fiscal_sequence_no for kiosk direct TPE, gated by config('fiscal.kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence') = true default). Counter-collect allocation path: PaymentService.php:241-243 `if ($locked->fiscal_sequence_no === null) { $locked->fiscal_sequence_no = app(FiscalSequenceService::class)->next($branch_id); }` — fires INSIDE the same DB::transaction as the PAID flip, so a fiscal-allocation hiccup rolls back the whole encaissement. Rationale: at kiosk creation, the order is not yet PAID — allocating a fiscal sequence number to an unpaid order would create gaps if customer walks away. Defer to counter-collect ensures the sequence is allocated 1:1 with money received.
edge_cases_audited.documentation_note: CLAUDE.md §8 nominal phrasing ('kiosk paid = sequence allocated at creation') could be clearer. Kiosk CARD/TICKET (online TPE confirm) allocates at finalizePaidKioskOrder; kiosk CASH (defer-to-counter) allocates at confirmCounterPayment. Both happen at the moment payment is confirmed, NOT at order creation. Recommend amending CLAUDE.md §8 to: 'kiosk online-paid (CARD/TICKET) = allocated at finalizePaidKioskOrder; kiosk counter-deferred CASH = allocated at confirmCounterPayment; POS direct cash = allocated at close.' Sister sentinel candidate: tests/Feature/Sentinels/FiscalAllocationTimingSentinelTest.php asserting kiosk-CASH never allocates sequence at FrontendOrder::create.

edge_cases_audited.name: Single-cashier idempotency cascade (double-click Confirm)
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Cashier double-clicks Confirm within ~16ms. Two POSTs hit /admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/confirm with IDENTICAL X-Idempotency-Key (PosCounterCollectModal.vue:350-353 builds `pos-counter-collect-${orderId}-${modeInt}-${minuteBucket}` — same minute bucket → same key). Middleware IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:67-82 computes scopedKey = `idempotency:v1:{branch_id}:{user_id}:sha256(key)` (user-scoped per H2-HEAL-01 commit 2c5b07c5e). First POST: Phase 2 acquires lock (line 99-103). Second POST 16ms later: Phase 1 finds NOT YET cached (first response not yet stored) → tries Phase 2 acquire → fails (lock already held by first) → calls `waitForCompletion` (line 105) for up to `idempotency.race_wait_ms` (default 1500ms). First POST commits, line 145-151 stores response under scopedKey. Second POST's waitForCompletion resolves → returns the cached 2xx → rebuildReplayResponse at line 117. Single DB::transaction → single PAID flip → single fiscal_sequence_no → single audit row → single OrderPaidAtCounter dispatch → single cash_movements. No double-charge. Verified at HEAD via reading lines 60-156 of IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php — formula unchanged since H2-HEAL-01.

edge_cases_audited.name: Cross-cashier idempotency post-H2-HEAL-01 (Cashier B replays Cashier A's key)
edge_cases_audited.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — fix holds at HEAD
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Pre-H2-HEAL-01 RED P0: scopedKey was `idempotency:v1:{branch_id}:sha256(key)` (no user_id). Cashier B could submit a request with Cashier A's (orderId, modeInt, minuteBucket) tuple — collision in cache → B replays A's cached response → B's frontend got A's order details, possible leakage. Post-H2-HEAL-01 commit 2c5b07c5e: scopedKey at IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:77-82 is `idempotency:v1:{branch_id}:{user_id}:sha256(key)`. Cashier A's bucket: `idempotency:v1:1:42:sha(pos-counter-collect-12345-1-...)`. Cashier B with same client key: `idempotency:v1:1:43:sha(pos-counter-collect-12345-1-...)` — DIFFERENT bucket. B's request bypasses A's cached response → hits PaymentService → sees `payment_status===PAID` short-circuit at :227-230 (K4.3 finding above) → returns 200 with the locked OrderDetailsResource. Confirmed: H2-HEAL-01 prevents the cross-user replay leak. RESIDUAL issue: K4.3 H9 silent-success toast for Cashier B — but data integrity intact, no second money movement, no cross-user data leakage (the order is the one Cashier A collected, single shared business object).
